name: Gorbag's Sword
game_text:
Bearer must be a <culture>Wraith</culture> Orc.
When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead.
If bearer is Gorbag, he is <keyword>fierce</keyword>.
flavor_text: “‘You touch it and I’ll stick this blade in your gut.’”
